notes.note: Ashram recording does not chant nyasa lines 4–8 or the purvapithika (13–24); the first dhyana shloka (9–12) is repeated at the end. Recording is PRIVATE: never host publicly (ask ashram first).

Recording replaced by the album copy (Akhila Ranganathan & Bhanumathy Viswanath, 'Lalitha Sahasranama Parayanakrama', track 1). Same recitation as the Ashram MP3/YouTube upload: identical length, 38 ms earlier start. Approved by Giri for the local (family) version.
Giri chose to publish the album recording on the public site (mathconcepts.github.io/Vak) so it plays without choosing a file; he confirmed he has permission to publish it on the web.
